description: Scaffold the Gradle multi-module Android project ('Linkup') with a pure-Kotlin JVM :core module, a Ktor :relay server module, and an Android :app module, plus the Gradle wrapper and version catalog. This establishes a baseline that compiles and whose :core and :relay modules are unit-testable in the sandbox (no Android SDK needed for them).
steps: Create settings.gradle.kts declaring rootProject.name = "Linkup" and including ":core", ":relay", and ":app". Add pluginManagement + dependencyResolutionManagement repositories: google(), mavenCentral().
Create root build.gradle.kts with plugins block using `apply false` for the android application, kotlin-android, kotlin-jvm, and (optionally) ktor plugins so subprojects apply them.

Create gradle/libs.versions.toml version catalog with versions for kotlin, agp (Android Gradle Plugin), coroutines, compose BOM, androidx core/lifecycle/activity-compose, ktor (server + client + websockets), kotlinx-serialization, junit, kotlin-test. Pin AGP to a stable 8.x line compatible with Gradle 8.14.5.

Create core/build.gradle.kts applying `kotlin("jvm")`, `java-library`, and kotlinx-serialization; depend on kotlinx-coroutines-core, kotlinx-serialization-json, and kotlin-test/junit for tests. No Android dependencies in :core.

Create relay/build.gradle.kts applying `kotlin("jvm")` + application plugin; depend on project(":core"), ktor-server-core/netty/websockets, logback, and ktor-server-test-host + ktor-client for tests. Set a mainClass (com.linkup.relay.MainKt).

Create app/build.gradle.kts applying the android application + kotlin-android + compose + serialization plugins; set namespace com.linkup.app, compileSdk 34, minSdk 26, targetSdk 34; enable Compose; depend on project(":core"), the androidx/compose catalog entries, and ktor-client (okhttp + websockets) for the relay client.
Generate the Gradle wrapper for 8.14.5 by running `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.14.5` in /projects/sandbox so ./gradlew exists and is committed.
Add a root .gitignore covering build/, .gradle/, local.properties, .idea/, *.iml, .cxx/, captures/.

Add a placeholder core/src/main/kotlin/com/linkup/core/Linkup.kt (version constant) and a trivial core/src/test/kotlin/com/linkup/core/LinkupTest.kt so :core:test has something to run and proves the test pipeline works.
acceptance_criteria: `./gradlew projects` lists :core, :relay and :app with no configuration errors.
`./gradlew :core:test` runs and passes the placeholder test in the sandbox (no Android SDK required).
`./gradlew :relay:compileKotlin` configures and compiles (even if no logic yet).
gradlew, gradlew.bat and gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties exist and reference 8.14.5.
verification: Run `./gradlew projects` and confirm :core, :relay and :app are listed.
Run `./gradlew :core:test` and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL with the placeholder test passing.

Note: do NOT attempt `:app:assembleDebug` here; the Android SDK is absent. Configuration-only evaluation of :app (via `./gradlew projects`) is acceptable; if AGP requires an SDK even to configure, document that and keep :app configured for the user's Android Studio.
findings:
COMPLETED. Scaffolded the Linkup Gradle (Kotlin DSL) multi-module project at /projects/sandbox and committed it (commit e391fca). Files created: settings.gradle.kts (rootProject.name=Linkup; includes :core, :relay, :app; pluginManagement + dependencyResolutionManagement with google()+mavenCentral()+gradlePluginPortal), root build.gradle.kts (plugins apply false via catalog aliases), gradle/libs.versions.toml (version catalog), core/relay/app build.gradle.kts, placeholder core/src/main/kotlin/com/linkup/core/Linkup.kt (VERSION=0.1.0, PROTOCOL_VERSION=1) + core/src/test/.../LinkupTest.kt (2 tests), relay Main.kt (mainClass com.linkup.relay.MainKt), app MainActivity.kt + AndroidManifest.xml + res/values/themes.xml + proguard-rules.pro, root .gitignore (build/, .gradle/, local.properties, .idea/, *.iml, .cxx/, captures/, .DS_Store), and gradle.properties.

Versions pinned (all mutually compatible with Gradle 8.14.5): AGP 8.7.3, Kotlin 2.0.21 (matches Gradle's embedded Kotlin), coroutines 1.9.0, kotlinx-serialization 1.7.3, Ktor 2.3.12, logback 1.5.8, compose-bom 2024.09.03, androidx core 1.13.1 / lifecycle 2.8.6 / activity-compose 1.9.2, junit 4.13.2. Compose uses the Kotlin 2.x compose compiler plugin (org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose). Modules use a Java 17 toolchain.

Gradle wrapper for 8.14.5 generated: gradlew, gradlew.bat, gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar, gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties (distributionUrl -> gradle-8.14.5-bin.zip). Wrapper generation had to be bootstrapped with the build scripts temporarily moved aside and an empty Groovy settings.gradle present, because of the JDK-25 issue below (the `gradle wrapper` invocation itself tries to compile the Kotlin DSL scripts and failed otherwise). The committed project keeps the Kotlin DSL scripts.

ENVIRONMENT ISSUE (resolved, important for later features): the sandbox default JDK is Java 25, but Gradle 8.14.5's embedded Kotlin DSL script compiler (Kotlin 2.0.21) cannot parse the Java 25 version string and throws `java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: 25.0.2` (org.jetbrains.kotlin.com.intellij.util.lang.JavaVersion.parse) while compiling *.gradle.kts. Any Kotlin-DSL Gradle invocation under JDK 25 fails this way. FIX: set `org.gradle.java.home=/opt/toolchains/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2` in gradle.properties so Gradle runs on the pre-installed JDK 17 (recommended runtime for AGP 8.7 / Gradle 8.14). After this, all Kotlin-DSL tasks work. Subsequent features MUST keep running Gradle on JDK 17 (do not remove that gradle.properties line); if their env lacks that exact JDK 17 path, point org.gradle.java.home at a JDK 11-21.

VERIFICATION (all pass, run on JDK 17 via gradle.properties):
- `./gradlew projects` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, lists :app, :core, :relay with no configuration errors. The Android :app module configures fine WITHOUT the Android SDK (no local.properties / sdk.dir needed just to configure with AGP 8.7.3).
- `./gradlew :core:test` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL; test report core/build/test-results/test/TEST-com.linkup.core.LinkupTest.xml shows tests=2, failures=0, skipped=0. JVM test pipeline proven.
- `./gradlew :relay:build` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL (compileKotlin + jar + startScripts + dist + assemble). :relay:compileKotlin compiles.
- Did NOT run :app:assembleDebug (no Android SDK, per plan). Only configuration-level evaluation of :app was done, which succeeds.

NOTES: Deprecation warnings about Gradle 9.0 compatibility are emitted but are non-fatal. Build output (build/, .gradle/) is gitignored and not committed. git repo initialized in /projects/sandbox; .agents/ and .kiro/ left untracked. Nothing pushed (per sub-agent scope).
